video_title: George Karl told DeMarcus Cousins he didn't even want him on the team 😳

quotes.summary_phrase: George Karl's controversial coaching style and relationship with DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.excerpt: he real controversial too. So a lot of players don't like him, he talking that shit about Melo.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: Talk to me about George Karl because I know the story. He real controversial too. So a lot of players don't like him, he talking that shit about Carmelo Anthony. Can you hate him?

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: Yeah, yeah. These are our co-workers, we know these guys. So I'm saying for you to actually play with him and hear that, what was your experience with him?

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: George Karl warned Tony Allen about the Kings' dysfunctional environment
quotes.excerpt: I got George Karl coming before I even step floor on the floor at all practice facility.
quotes.quote: I got George Karl coming before I even step floor on the floor at all practice facility. I got George Karl calling and saying, 'Yo, this is a shit show. Don't get it twisted. You are walking into a shit show.' He let you know. You are going to have to keep your head down and just grind it out. And I was just like, 'Damn, are you sure?' Everything seemed cool. But that shit was crazy. Just the dynamic with him and DeMarcus Cousins. It wasn't even that he was a bad coach, he was probably not a good coach for us. It was a bunch of misfits on one team, and Cousins is the leader of it.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen's relationship with DeMarcus Cousins and John Wall
quotes.excerpt: every question anybody asks me, 'Who's the toughest player you ever had to guard?' I say Boogie Cousins.
quotes.quote: I came in like a little brother. He took care of him and John Wall, took care of us out there in Vegas, Summer League. So I already felt like, man, I'll go to war with them. I'll go to war for them. Every question anybody asks me, 'Who's the toughest player you ever had to guard? Who's the toughest?' I say DeMarcus Cousins every single turn. This is a big guard, fundamentally, know how to use his body. So I was hyped to come in there and kind of learn from him as a big and get to play next side of him and kind of just go under his wing.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: George Karl told DeMarcus Cousins he didn't want him on the team
quotes.excerpt: this guy already told you before we even started that he didn't want you on the team.
quotes.quote: I don't fault him for doing the crash out when this guy already told you before we even started that he didn't want you on the team, and you the best guy on the team. So that's tough to deal with. You can't even say nothing about it.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: George Karl's coaching decisions hindered DeMarcus Cousins' development
quotes.excerpt: I'm the rookie, I'm the sixth pick, and I don't get to develop down 20?
quotes.quote: There was a game, I think we were playing against Detroit, and down by like 20 in probably the third quarter. I go to post up, and Cousins is about to throw me the ball. Right before I catch the ball, George Karl calls a timeout and starts yelling at everybody, 'What are you doing? We don't post him. We don't give him the ball on the block.' And so this is, I'm the rookie, I'm the sixth pick, and I don't get to develop down 20? So that kind of put a deter on my whole development anyways. I'm thinking, well, here's my head coach, I'm the rookie, I'm the sixth pick, and I don't get to develop down 20?

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins' frustration with his contract and role
quotes.excerpt: there's no way I'm worth 95 million less than them. That don't make no fucking sense to me.
quotes.quote: I'm with DeMarcus Cousins and D'Angelo Russell, and they getting to show that they worth 150, 100. DeMarcus Cousins, they worth 100, and I'm like, I was just in the gym with these dudes one-on-one, busting their ass, doing the same drills they doing. I'm like, there's no way I'm worth 95 million less than them. That don't make no fucking sense to me. So my drive to do it was more like, I don't believe that they're worth 100 more million dollars than me. That don't make sense to me on a contractual level, not when, like you said, the effort stuff.
